title: [GMCP 203.040.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, and diagnostics
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-040-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: GMCP emits bounded OpenTelemetry-compatible traces, metrics and structured logs across host, gateway, transport, server and callback boundaries, propagating standard trace context from MCP metadata. RED/USE, queue, cache, policy, consent, task and lifecycle signals have stable schemas and cardinality budgets; payload redaction is structural; diagnostics explain failures locally and export only under explicit policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
